title: ir.routing.outcome.observed
description: Decision D7: emitted from MVP-4 for guider verdicts and human hold resolutions -- the wide decision record's outcome side is built during the MVP rather than deferred to the Adaptive track's AD-1.

verdict.description: guider: pass|fail|unavailable|uncertain (FR-IRG-GDR-04). human: approve|edit|reject (hold-queue resolution, FR-IRG-UI-03).

label.description: Human label on an integrity review resolved alongside this outcome (Trust Architecture §6.4); only present for signal_type=human resolutions tied to an integrity hold.
